title.narrative: Scaling up of interventions to combat malaria in Côte d’Ivoire - Côte d'Ivoire (01-Jan-2021-31-Dec-2023)

description.narrative: Côte d'Ivoire, Malaria, Save the Children Federation, Inc. (STC HQ)This program has the following goals: D'ici fin 2025, réduire le taux de mortalité lié au paludisme d'au moins 75% (par rapport à 2015) / By the end of 2025, reduce the mortality rate due to malaria by at least 75% (compared to 2015). D'ici fin 2025, réduire le taux d'incidence des cas de paludisme d'au moins 75% (par rapport à 2015) / By the end of 2025, reduce the malaria incidence rate by at least 75% (compared to 2015). The objectives of this program are: Accroître de 63,2% en 2019 à 80% en 2025, la proportion de la population qui dort sous une moustiquaire imprégnée d’insecticide d’ici 2025 / Increase the proportion of the population sleeping under an insecticide-treated net from 63.2% in 2019 to 80% in 2025. Accroître de 53% en 2018 à 80% en 2025, la proportion de femmes enceintes qui prend les trois doses de SP d’ici fin 2025 / Increase the proportion of pregnant women taking all three doses of SP from 53% in 2018 to 80% in 2025. D’ici fin 2025, au moins 90% des cas de paludisme sont confirmés et pris en charge selon les directives nationales dans les structures sanitaires publiques et privées ainsi que dans la communauté / By the end of 2025, at least 90% of malaria cases are confirmed and treated according to national guidelines in public and private health facilities and in the community.. D'ici fin 2025, renforcement et maintien des capacités de gestion, de coordination et de partenariat du programme pour atteindre les performances à tous les niveaux / By the end of 2025, strengthen and maintain the programme's management, coordination and partnership capacities to achieve performance at all levels.

title.narrative: Outcome indicators targets and results for CIV-M-SCIP03
Proportion of households with at least one insecticide-treated net for every two people and/or sprayed by IRS within the last 12 months
Proportion of pregnant women who slept under an insecticide-treated net the previous night
Proportion of children under five years old who slept under an insecticide-treated net the previous night
Proportion of population that slept under an insecticide-treated net the previous night
Proportion of population with access to an ITN within their household
Proportion of malaria cases (presumed and confirmed) that received first line antimalarial treatment at private sector sites
Impact indicators targets and results for CIV-M-SCIP03
Malaria parasite prevalence: Proportion of children aged 6-59 months with malaria infection
In-patient malaria deaths: rate per 100,000 persons per year
Confirmed malaria cases (microscopy or RDT): rate per 1000 persons per year
Malaria test positivity rate
All-cause under-5 mortality rate per 1000 live births
Coverage / Output indicators targets and results for CIV-M-SCIP03
SPI - Other 1: Proportion of pregnant women lost to follow-up who were found and referred and who received the third dose of intermittent preventive treatment for malaria
VC - other 1: Number of people reached by outreach activities for awareness-raising on measures to prevent and treat malaria
Proportion of confirmed malaria cases that received first-line antimalarial treatment in the community
Proportion of suspected malaria cases that receive a parasitological test in the community
Percentage of service delivery reports from community health workers integrated into HMIS
Proportion of community health workers who received at least one supportive supervision during the reporting period
